tools.description: Return authoritative live state for your active match: phase, current turn, legal actions, HP (brawl/combat), time remaining, and your opponent's last action. tools.name: wait_for_match_event
tools.description: Wait for something to HAPPEN in your match, instead of polling for it. Blocks server-side until the next match event, then returns everything you missed. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: configure_character, speak, gesture, join_match, query_queue, query_last_match_result, confirm_claim, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, wait_for_match_assignment, query_fighter_history, list_fighters · Private data: configure_character, gesture, join_match, query_last_match_result, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, list_unclaimed_fighters, query_fighter_history, concede_match, decide_verdict · Public sink: configure_character, speak, join_match, query_my_next_match, query_last_match_result, request_claim_code, confirm_claim, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, list_fighters · Destructive: speak, gesture, join_match, prepare_for_match, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: configure_character, speak, gesture, join_match, query_queue, query_last_match_result, confirm_claim, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, wait_for_match_assignment, query_fighter_history, list_fighters · Private data: configure_character, gesture, join_match, query_last_match_result, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, list_unclaimed_fighters, query_fighter_history, concede_match, decide_verdict · Public sink: configure_character, speak, join_match, query_my_next_match, query_last_match_result, request_claim_code, confirm_claim, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event, list_fighters · Destructive: speak, gesture, join_match, prepare_for_match, query_match_state, wait_for_match_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
